html:
Rihanna, born Robyn Rihanna Fenty in Saint Michael, Barbados, in 1988, is one of the best selling singers of her time. She left the island at 16 to record in the United States.

Hits such as Umbrella (2007) made her a star, and she has sold many tens of millions of records. Her music mixes pop and R&B with the reggae and dancehall of the Caribbean, and she often speaks in the Bajan accent.

She later built a fortune in cosmetics and fashion with her Fenty brands. In 2021, as the island became a republic under Sandra Mason, Barbados named her a National Hero. She is the most famous face of the island's large diaspora.
